annotations.title: Check: analyse a wallet with a credit

description: Spends ONE paid credit on the networks it paid: evmWallet on the EVM networks paid, solanaWallet on Solana if it was paid. Give a wallet for each family the credit paid (check_wallet_missing otherwise) and none for a family it did not (check_family_not_paid). The free screening (OFAC SDN, issuer freeze) and Scorechain read each wallet once, Merkle Science (through Didit) once per network, at most the networks paid plus 2 lookups in all. Returns check with status used, target { wallets { evm, svm }, networks }, seal (the worst network: red, risk found; yellow, medium risk; grey, a paid reading did not come back; green, no risk, Merkle no_data included), result and screening (of the worst network), networks [{ chainId, seal, result { verdict, risk, tools [{ tool, result clear|flagged|unavailable, score 0-100, severity, summary, category, factors, sourceOfFunds, destinationOfFunds, analyzedAt, fromHistory }], details }, screening }] and events (the real steps, with ms). The same credit and the same wallets again answers what is stored, with no provider call; other wallets are check_credit_used (409). Two calls at once run ONE analysis (the other gets check_running, 409). check_unreadable (503): a reading did not answer, the credit is still valid, call again with the same arguments (details.missing names tool:network). analysis_tool_unavailable (503): a tool is down and the credit was not touched.

checkId.description: The Check id from check_charge (CHK-...). It is the capability of this Check: keep it, and keep it private.

evmWallet.description: The EVM wallet to analyse (0x...), when the credit paid an EVM network.

solanaWallet.description: The Solana wallet to analyse (base58, case-sensitive), when the credit paid Solana.

wallet.description: Instead of the two above, for a credit of one family: the wallet, its family read from the address.

name: check_analyze
